messages:
Rhea (Finance): Saw a weird $38k GPU charge on hosted-models invoice labeled customer=acme but team=unassigned. Need rapid ownership so we can close month-end books.

ops-bot: Alert: gpu_monthly_anomaly project=hosted-models peak on 2026-02-15. Details: /alerts/178200.

Noah (Infra): Can you paste the invoice row or run cost-lookup? Untagged workloads get dropped to unassigned.

Rhea (Finance): From cost export:
`2026-02-15 hosted-models gpu A100 $38,120 tags: customer=acme,team=null,job=acme-ltr-sweep`

Ivy (ML): `acme-ltr-sweep` is ours — we were running a latency/resilience grid for ACME POC. Looks like one batch used the reserved template (non-preempt) by mistake.

Noah (Infra): Quick mapping command:
```
cost-lookup --project hosted-models --filter "job==acme-ltr-sweep" --group-by template,instance_type
```
This will show if non-preemptible templates were used. I can also correlate job -> repo -> CODEOWNERS.

Rhea (Finance): We need a provisional allocation today. If ML covers >$20k it requires director sign-off. Can infra provide owner mapping and a provisional split?

Noah (Infra): Mapped job -> owner: Ivy and ML team. Provisional split: ML (Ivy) $31,600, Sales POC budget $6,520 (customer-facing). Sending CSV shortly.

Ivy (ML): Confirmed the sweep used `template: gpu-reserved-lock` for two batches. We'll absorb $10k and request the remainder be charged to the POC budget. How do we request that transfer?

Rhea (Finance): File FIN-6112 in finance-tools with the CSV and short justification: "POC run used reserved template; request charge to ACME POC budget." I'll pre-approve up to $10k; remainder needs finance director approval.

Noah (Infra): Short-term: adding a pre-submit check to warn on `reserved` templates for POC jobs and require `--confirm-reserved` flag. Also enforcing team tag.

Rhea (Finance): Thanks — ticket FIN-6112 created. We'll close month-end once director signs off or POC budget accepts charge. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Ticket FIN-6112 created by Rhea (Finance)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-6112

Ivy (ML): Will follow up with Sales to confirm POC budget acceptance and update the ticket.
